verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents custom machine templates that capture a machine's configuration and can be selected at machine creation to reproduce your specs. Deployments run your container images, and full root access on VMs lets you build the exact environment. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on bringing a custom Docker image (e.g. private registries, or custom containers for Notebooks/Workflows), details on the template creation workflow, and independent hands-on corroboration of templates or custom images.
